host_model.selection: Existing authenticated host with its inherited model; no model override or separate API call. Record concrete identity only if observed before preparing a revised campaign.

budget.cost_enforcement: The host exposes no trustworthy per-run cost; no monetary cap or zero-cost claim is inferred.

interruption: Controller interruption and duplicate collection are independent deterministic failure controls. A real interrupted host run must be collected as interrupted and retained; it cannot be replaced silently or counted as successful recovery.
limits: Two repetitions are a small pilot, not a model-quality benchmark.
No new model version or quality advantage is inferred from offline replay.
The caller owns host permissions, isolation and deadline enforcement.
